## Imputation

```{r}
library(mice)

#Set up imputation matrix 
ini <- mice(final, maxit = 0)
meth <- ini$method
pred <- ini$predictorMatrix

#Only impute for the 3 missing variables that go into Framingham calculation
#Predictive mean mathcing 
meth[] <- ""
meth["total_cholesterol"] <- "pmm"
meth["hdl_cholesterol"] <- "pmm"
meth["crc_systolic"] <- "pmm"
meth["calcfields_fh_final"] <- ""

pred[,] <- 0

#PREDICTOR MATRIX
pred["total_cholesterol", c("age_appt_average", "screening_sex", "nihtoolbox_years_education", "race_f", "ethnicity_f", "tbi_hx_f", "any_psych_hx", "fitness_bmi", "frs_diabetes", "frs_med", "crc_systolic", "crc_diastolic", "frs_hypertension", "frs_smoking", "max_hr_bpm", "fitness_fatpercent", "dxa_visceral_volume", "whole_skeleton_fa", "WM.hypointensities_volume", "num_potholes_fa")] <- 1
pred["hdl_cholesterol", c("age_appt_average", "screening_sex", "nihtoolbox_years_education", "race_f", "ethnicity_f", "tbi_hx_f", "any_psych_hx", "fitness_bmi", "frs_diabetes", "frs_med", "crc_systolic", "crc_diastolic", "frs_hypertension", "frs_smoking", "max_hr_bpm", "fitness_fatpercent", "dxa_visceral_volume", "whole_skeleton_fa", "WM.hypointensities_volume", "num_potholes_fa")] <- 1
pred["crc_systolic", c("age_appt_average", "screening_sex", "nihtoolbox_years_education", "race_f", "ethnicity_f", "tbi_hx_f", "any_psych_hx", "fitness_bmi", "ldl_cholesterol", "non_hdl_cholesterol", "hdl_cholesterol", "total_cholesterol", "triglycerides", "glucose", "hemoglobin_a1c", "insulin", "frs_diabetes", "frs_med", "frs_hypertension", "frs_smoking", "max_hr_bpm", "fitness_fatpercent", "dxa_visceral_volume", "whole_skeleton_fa", "WM.hypointensities_volume", "num_potholes_fa")] <- 1

# 1.m = 1 for single imputation
imp <- mice(
  final,
  method = meth,
  predictorMatrix = pred,
  m = 1,                
  maxit = 5,             
  seed = 123
)

# 2. Extract the completed master dataset
final_imp <- complete(imp, 1)
```

## Framingham Calculations

Calculation for women, untreated

100*(1-(0.95012)^((2.71828182845904)^(sum((log(\[frs_age\])*2.32888),(log(\[total_cholesterol\])*1.20904),(log(\[hdl_cholesterol\])*(-0.70833)),(log(\[crc_systolic\])*2.76157),(\[frs_smoking\]*0.52873),(\[frs_diabetes\]\*0.69154),(-26.1931)))))

Calculation for man, untreated

100*(1-(0.88936)^((2.71828182845904)^(sum((log(\[frs_age\])*3.06117),(log(\[total_cholesterol\])*1.12370),(log(\[hdl_cholesterol\])*(-0.93263)),(log(\[crc_systolic\])*1.93303),(\[frs_smoking\]*0.65451),(\[frs_diabetes\]\*0.57367),(-23.9802)))))

## Basic Analysis Setup: Whole Brain Potholes

```{r}
library(MASS)
library(performance)
library(pscl)

#Number of clusters, covariates only
whole_brain_clusters_1 <- glm.nb(
  num_potholes_fa ~
    log_icv_c +
    education_c +
    screening_sex +
    framingham_c +
    any_psych_hx,
  data = final_imp
)

summary(whole_brain_clusters_1)
pR2(whole_brain_clusters_1)
performance::model_performance(whole_brain_clusters_1)
exp(coef(whole_brain_clusters_1))
exp(confint(whole_brain_clusters_1))

#Number of clusters, covariates and linear age
whole_brain_clusters_2 <- glm.nb(
  num_potholes_fa ~
    log_icv_c +
    education_c +
    screening_sex +
    framingham_c +
    any_psych_hx +
    age_c,
  data = final_imp
)

summary(whole_brain_clusters_2)

performance::model_performance(whole_brain_clusters_2)

car::vif(whole_brain_clusters_2)
anova(whole_brain_clusters_1, whole_brain_clusters_2)
```


## Memory

```{r}
cog <- read.csv("Z:/Projects/CMPA_2021B092/Data/behavioral/cog01.csv")

cog <- dplyr::select(cog, anon_subid,
                     cvlt_trials1_5_raw, cvlt_ldfr_raw,
                     cvlt_recog_hits_raw, cvlt_fps_raw,
                     wms_lm1_raw, wms_lm2_raw, lm_recog_raw,
                     bvmtr_totalraw, bvmtr_delayraw, picsequence_raw)

#sample with memory data
data2 <- merge(final_imp, cog, by="anon_subid", all=FALSE)

#check for problematic neuropsych data -- none
count(data2, appointment_cautions___1)
count(data2, appointment_cautions___2)

#CALCULATE COMPOSITE SCORES********
#EPISODIC MEMORY #
#Calculate cvlt recognition discrimination score
data2$cvlt_recog_discrim <- (data2$cvlt_recog_hits_raw - data2$cvlt_fps_raw)
#Create data2frame with only episodic memory measures & anon_subid
memory_comp_calc <- dplyr::select(data2, anon_subid, cvlt_trials1_5_raw, cvlt_ldfr_raw, cvlt_recog_discrim, wms_lm1_raw, wms_lm2_raw, lm_recog_raw, bvmtr_totalraw, bvmtr_delayraw, picsequence_raw)
#Change episodic memory variable names to indicate they're z-scored
names(memory_comp_calc)[2:10] <- 
  paste(names(memory_comp_calc)[2:10], "zscore", sep = "_")
#z-score episodic memory variables & convert to numeric
for (i in 2:10) {
  memory_comp_calc[,i] <- scale(memory_comp_calc[,i])
}
for (i in 2:10) {
  memory_comp_calc[,i] <- as.numeric((memory_comp_calc[,i]))
}
#calculate composites -- higher scores reflect better performance
#no inverse coding required
memory_comp_calc$mem_comp <- rowMeans(memory_comp_calc[2:10])
#convert composite scores to numeric
memory_comp_calc[[11]] <- as.numeric(memory_comp_calc[[11]])

#merge back into master data2frame, keeping all participants who are in both files 
data2 <- merge(data2, memory_comp_calc, by="anon_subid", all=FALSE)
```

```{r}
  mem_comp ~ 
    log_icv_c +
    framingham_c +
    education_c +
    screening_sex +
    any_psych_hx +
    age_c + fornix_fa +
    full_jhu_fx_Voxels,
  data = data2
)
summary(mem_fornix_potholes_2)

fx_hurdle_5 <- hurdle(
  full_jhu_fx_NumClusters ~
    log_icv_c +
    education_c +
    screening_sex +
    framingham_c +
    any_psych_hx +
    age_c + mem_comp,
  data = data2,
  dist = "negbin"
)

summary(fx_hurdle_5)

library(lavaan)

age_med_model <- '
  full_jhu_fx_NumClusters ~ a*age_appt_average + screening_sex + education_c + log_icv_c + framingham_c +
    any_psych_hx

  mem_comp ~ b*full_jhu_fx_NumClusters + c*age_appt_average +
    screening_sex + education_c + log_icv_c + framingham_c +
    any_psych_hx

  indirect := a*b
  total := c + (a*b)
'

fit_age <- sem(
  age_med_model,
  data = data2,
  se = "bootstrap",
  bootstrap = 5000
)

summary(fit_age, standardized = TRUE)
```

## Figures

```{r}
# ---- shared setup ----
age_center <- mean(final_imp$age_appt_average - final_imp$age_c, na.rm = TRUE)

sig_style    <- list(lwd = 3, lty = 1, alpha = 1)
nonsig_style <- list(lwd = 1.75, lty = 2, alpha = 0.65)

age_seq <- seq(min(final_imp$age_c, na.rm = TRUE),
               max(final_imp$age_c, na.rm = TRUE),
               length.out = 200)
n <- length(age_seq)
age_seq_raw <- age_seq + age_center

sex_ref   <- levels(final_imp$screening_sex)[1]
psych_ref <- sort(unique(final_imp$any_psych_hx))[1]

pred_data <- data.frame(
  age_c = age_seq,
  age2_c = age_seq^2,
  log_icv_c = rep(0, n),
  education_c = rep(0, n),
  framingham_c = rep(0, n),
  screening_sex = factor(rep(sex_ref, n), levels = levels(final_imp$screening_sex)),
  any_psych_hx = rep(psych_ref, n)
)

plot(final_imp$age_appt_average,
     final_imp$whole_skeleton_fa,
     xlab = "Age (Years)",
     ylab = "Whole Skeleton Mean FA",
     main = "Age-Related Changes in Whole Skeleton Mean FA",
     pch = 16,
     col = "gray60")

pred_linear    <- predict(whole_brain_fa_2, newdata = pred_data)
pred_quadratic <- predict(whole_brain_fa_3, newdata = pred_data)

lines(age_seq_raw, pred_linear,
      col = "red", lwd = sig_style$lwd, lty = sig_style$lty)

lines(age_seq_raw, pred_quadratic,
      col = adjustcolor("blue", alpha.f = nonsig_style$alpha),
      lwd = nonsig_style$lwd, lty = nonsig_style$lty)

legend("topright",
       legend = c("Linear model *", "Quadratic model"),
       col = c("red", adjustcolor("blue", alpha.f = nonsig_style$alpha)),
       lty = c(sig_style$lty, nonsig_style$lty),
       lwd = c(sig_style$lwd, nonsig_style$lwd),
       bty = "n")

plot(final_imp$age_appt_average,
     final_imp$num_potholes_fa,
     xlab = "Age (Years)",
     ylab = "Total Number of Potholes",
     main = "Age-Related Pothole Burden",
     pch = 16,
     col = "gray60")

pred_linear    <- predict(whole_brain_clusters_2, newdata = pred_data, type = "response")
pred_quadratic <- predict(whole_brain_clusters_3, newdata = pred_data, type = "response")

lines(age_seq_raw, pred_linear,
      col = "red", lwd = sig_style$lwd, lty = 1)
lines(age_seq_raw, pred_quadratic,
      col = "blue", lwd = sig_style$lwd, lty = 2)

legend("topleft",
       legend = c("Linear model *", "Quadratic model *"),
       col = c("red", "blue"),
       lty = c(1, 2),
       lwd = c(sig_style$lwd, sig_style$lwd),
       bty = "n")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# TBI history -> probability of any fornix pothole
# (zero-hurdle component of the hurdle() model)
# ============================================================
library(ggplot2)
library(MASS)   # mvrnorm for simulation-based CIs
library(pscl)

set.seed(123)

# Get actual levels for BOTH character columns from the data itself
psych_levels <- sort(unique(final_imp$any_psych_hx))
tbi_levels   <- sort(unique(final_imp$tbi_hx))
print(tbi_levels)  # confirm these are e.g. "No TBI" "TBI" in the order you expect

# Prediction rows: TBI = No vs Yes, all else at reference/mean
newdat <- data.frame(
  log_icv_c     = 0,
  education_c   = 0,
  screening_sex = factor(levels(final_imp$screening_sex)[1],
                         levels = levels(final_imp$screening_sex)),
  framingham_c  = 0,
  any_psych_hx  = factor(psych_levels[1], levels = psych_levels),
  age_c         = 0,
  tbi_hx        = factor(tbi_levels, levels = tbi_levels)   # both levels, in their real order
)

# predict(type = "prob") gives P(Y = k); P(pothole present) = 1 - P(Y = 0)
prob_mat  <- predict(fx_hurdle_3, newdata = newdat, type = "prob")
point_est <- 1 - prob_mat[, 1]

# Simulation-based 95% CI (parametric bootstrap on coefficients)
coefs <- coef(fx_hurdle_3)
vc    <- vcov(fx_hurdle_3)
n_sim <- 2000
sim_coefs <- mvrnorm(n_sim, mu = coefs, Sigma = vc)

zero_idx <- grep("^zero_", names(coefs))   # confirm this matches names(coef(fornix_hurdle))
Xz <- model.matrix(~ log_icv_c + education_c + screening_sex + framingham_c +
                     any_psych_hx + age_c + tbi_hx, data = newdat)

sim_probs <- apply(sim_coefs[, zero_idx], 1, function(b) plogis(Xz %*% b))
ci_lo <- apply(sim_probs, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
ci_hi <- apply(sim_probs, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)

panelB_df <- data.frame(
  tbi_hx = factor(tbi_levels, levels = tbi_levels),
  prob   = point_est,
  lo     = ci_lo,
  hi     = ci_hi
)

panelB <- ggplot(panelB_df, aes(x = tbi_hx, y = prob, fill = tbi_hx)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("gray70", "blue")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Predicted probability\nof \u22651 fornix pothole",
       title = "TBI history associated with higher fornix pothole likelihood") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

panelB
#ggsave("tbi_pothole_probability.png", panelB, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Fornix pothole count -> memory (adjusted partial effect)
# ============================================================
library(visreg)
library(ggplot2)

mem_model_full <- lm(mem_comp ~ log_icv_c + framingham_c + education_c + screening_sex + any_psych_hx + age_c + fornix_fa + full_jhu_fx_NumClusters, data = data2)

panelC <- visreg(mem_model_full, "full_jhu_fx_NumClusters", gg = TRUE,
                 points = list(size = 2, col = "gray40"), line = list(col = "blue")) +
  labs(x = "Number of fornix potholes",
       y = "Memory composite\n(adjusted partial effect)",
       title = "More fornix potholes are associated with worse memory") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

# find which layer is the fitted line (usually GeomLine)
line_idx <- which(sapply(panelC$layers, function(l) inherits(l$geom, "GeomLine")))
panelC$layers[[line_idx]]$aes_params$colour <- "blue"
ribbon_idx <- which(sapply(panelC$layers, function(l) inherits(l$geom, "GeomRibbon")))
panelC$layers[[ribbon_idx]]$aes_params$fill <- "blue"

panelC$layers[[ribbon_idx]]$aes_params$fill  <- "blue"
panelC$layers[[ribbon_idx]]$aes_params$alpha <- 0.15
panelC
#ggsave("fornix_pothole_memory.png", panelC, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
